CommunityApplications.Profile:
**DebridDownloader** is a downloader for Real-Debrid, TorBox, Premiumize and AllDebrid. Add a magnet or a .torrent file, pick the files you want, and they download to your server over several connections at once, resuming after dropped connections and restarts.
The container here is the headless DebridDownloader: the same download engine as the desktop app, with its interface in your browser on port 8777.
DebridDownloader is free and open source (GPL-3.0), with desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux.
Support: https://github.com/CasaVargas/DebridDownloader/issues
